paragraphs: FIDO Tech sells water leak detection built on artificial intelligence to utilities, municipalities and businesses. The company describes itself as a global water technology company.

One service locates a leak on any pressurised distribution pipe, in any material, using the same device. Another monitors system-wide leakage and severity continually, so interventions can be prioritised and investment informed. The company says its system ranks leaks by size, verifies the integrity of repair work and validates volumetric savings.

Published case studies include leak location for the City of Goodyear, Arizona. Others cover network monitoring for Northumbrian Water in the UK. The company states that its partnership with Microsoft started in 2023 with a joint project to replenish water in London. A news item on the site announces the appointment of Mitch Donnelly as chief executive.
